title: Ivo and the Silence
author: Oscar Oyelaran
blurb: Ines Yarrow, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
